# git



Git ZSH module providing aliases, functions, and workflow helpers for version control 



## Features

- Git aliases for common commands (gst, gco, gbr, glg)
- Branch management helpers (create, delete, rename, sync)
- Interactive rebase and merge workflow support
- Git status and log enhancements
- Upstream remote management






## Requirements

- zsh (loaded as part of dotfiles zsh modules)
